scout_questions.motivation: The 'cyl' distribution shows 8 cylinders as the most common, yet intuitively more cylinders often mean lower `mpg`. Investigating this trade-off reveals insights into the design philosophy of these vehicles.

scout_questions.entry_point: Identify cars with `hp` above the mean and `wt` below the mean, then examine their `qsec` values to see if any are unexpectedly high.

  "view_requested": {
    "name": "mpg_vs_weight_by_am_with_trend",
    "sql": "WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    am,
    AVG(wt) AS avg_wt,
    AVG(mpg) AS avg_mpg,
    SUM((wt - AVG(wt)) * (mpg - AVG(mpg))) AS cov,
    SUM((wt - AVG(wt)) * (wt - AVG(wt))) AS var
  FROM cars
  GROUP BY am
)
SELECT
  c.wt,
  c.mpg,
  c.am,
  CASE WHEN c.am = 0 THEN 'Automatic' ELSE 'Manual' END AS trans,
  gs.cov / gs.var AS slope,
  gs.avg_mpg - (gs.cov / gs.var) * gs.avg_wt AS intercept
FROM cars c
JOIN group_stats gs ON c.am = gs.am;"
  }
}

message:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN cyl = 8 THEN 'cyl=8' ELSE 'cyl<8' END AS group,
  AVG(mpg) AS mpg_mean,
  AVG(hp) AS hp_mean,
  AVG(wt) AS wt_mean,
  AVG(qsec) AS qsec_mean,
  AVG(hp / mpg) AS hp_per_mpg_mean,
  AVG(wt / mpg) AS wt_per_mpg_mean,
  AVG(qsec / mpg) AS qsec_per_mpg_mean
FROM cars
GROUP BY group;
Return a single result set with the columns listed above.

   ABS((hp - AVG(hp) OVER()) / STDDEV_POP(hp) OVER()) +
   ABS((wt - AVG(wt) OVER()) / STDDEV_POP(wt) OVER()) +
   ABS((disp - AVG(disp) OVER()) / STDDEV_POP(disp) OVER())) AS composite_score,
  residual_mpg,
  residual_wt
FROM cars
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 5;

  SELECT column00, mpg, hp, wt, disp,
         mpg / hp AS mpg_per_hp,

  FROM cars
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(mpg_per_hp) AS mean_mpg_per_hp,
    STDDEV_POP(mpg_per_hp) AS std_mpg_per_hp,
    AVG(wt_per_disp) AS mean_wt_per_disp,
    STDDEV_POP(wt_per_disp) AS std_wt_per_disp
  FROM ratios
),
z_scores AS (
  SELECT r.*, s.mean_mpg_per_hp, s.std_mpg_per_hp,
         s.mean_wt_per_disp, s.std_wt_per_disp,
         (r.mpg_per_hp - s.mean_mpg_per_hp) / s.std_mpg_per_hp AS z_mpg_per_hp,
         (r.wt_per_disp - s.mean_wt_per_disp) / s.std_wt_per_disp AS z_wt_per_disp
  FROM ratios r
  CROSS JOIN stats s
),
outliers AS (
  SELECT *, 'mpg_per_hp' AS flag
  FROM z_scores
  UNION ALL
  SELECT *, 'wt_per_disp' AS flag
  FROM z_scores
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY flag ORDER BY CASE WHEN flag='mpg_per_hp' THEN ABS(z_mpg_per_hp) WHEN flag='wt_per_disp' THEN ABS(z_wt_per_disp) END DESC) AS rn
  FROM outliers
)

WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY flag, rn;"
  }
}

The calculation used only standard SQL aggregates (COUNT, SUM, SQRT, POWER) and no extensions.",
  "view_requested": {
    "name": "gear_carb_resid_filter",
    "sql": "WITH counts AS (
  SELECT gear, carb, COUNT(*) AS obs
  FROM cars
  GROUP BY gear, carb
),
row_totals AS (
  SELECT gear, SUM(obs) AS row_total
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY gear
),
col_totals AS (
  SELECT carb, SUM(obs) AS col_total
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY carb
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(obs) AS grand_total FROM counts
),
cont AS (
  SELECT c.gear,
         c.carb,
         c.obs,
         rt.row_total,
         ct.col_total,
         gt.grand_total,
         (rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / gt.grand_total AS exp,
         (c.obs - (rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / gt.grand_total) / SQRT((rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / gt.grand_total) AS resid,
         POWER(c.obs - (rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / gt.grand_total, 2) / ((rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / gt.grand_total) AS chi2,
         c.obs / ((rt.row_total * ct.col_total) / gt.grand_total) AS ratio
  FROM counts c
  JOIN row_totals rt ON c.gear = rt.gear
  JOIN col_totals ct ON c.carb = ct.carb
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT gear, carb, obs, exp, resid, chi2, ratio
  FROM cont
  WHERE resid < -2
),
overall AS (
  SELECT SUM(chi2) AS chi2
  FROM cont
),
final AS (
  SELECT gear, carb, obs, exp, resid, chi2, ratio, 0 AS is_total
  FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'TOTAL', 'TOTAL', NULL, NULL, NULL, overall.chi2, NULL, 1 AS is_total
  FROM overall
)
SELECT gear, carb, obs, exp, resid, chi2, ratio
FROM final
ORDER BY is_total, resid;"
  }
}

  "view_requested": {
    "name": "car_hp_disp_zscore",
    "sql": "WITH ratios AS (
  SELECT column00, cyl, disp, hp, hp/disp AS ratio, vs, am, gear, carb
  FROM cars
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio, STDDEV_POP(ratio) AS std_ratio
  FROM ratios
),
z_scores AS (
  SELECT r.*, (r.ratio - s.mean_ratio)/s.std_ratio AS z_score
  FROM ratios r CROSS JOIN stats s
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN abs(z_score) > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag
  FROM z_scores
),
combined AS (
  SELECT column00, cyl, disp, hp, ratio, z_score, flag, vs, am, gear, carb, 0 AS is_summary
  FROM flagged
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'mean_ratio', NULL, NULL, NULL, mean_ratio, std_ratio, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1 AS is_summary
  FROM stats
)
SELECT column00, cyl, disp, hp, ratio, z_score, flag, vs, am, gear, carb
FROM combined
ORDER BY is_summary, z_score DESC;"
  }
}

  "view_requested": {
    "name": "car_mpg_per_hp_analysis",
    "sql": "WITH base AS (
  SELECT column00, mpg, hp, disp, wt,
         ROUND(mpg / hp, 2) AS mpg_per_hp,
         CASE
           WHEN hp BETWEEN 50 AND 80 THEN '50-80'
           WHEN hp BETWEEN 81 AND 110 THEN '81-110'
           WHEN hp BETWEEN 111 AND 140 THEN '111-140'
           WHEN hp BETWEEN 141 AND 170 THEN '141-170'
           WHEN hp BETWEEN 171 AND 200 THEN '171-200'
           WHEN hp >= 201 THEN '201+'
         END AS hp_bucket
  FROM cars
),
stats AS (
  SELECT hp_bucket,
         ROUND(AVG(mpg_per_hp), 2) AS mean_mpg_per_hp,
         ROUND(STDDEV_POP(mpg_per_hp), 2) AS stddev_mpg_per_hp
  FROM base
  GROUP BY hp_bucket
),
main AS (
  SELECT b.column00,
         ROUND(b.mpg, 2) AS mpg,
         ROUND(b.hp, 2) AS hp,
         ROUND(b.disp, 2) AS disp,
         ROUND(b.wt, 2) AS wt,
         b.mpg_per_hp,
         b.hp_bucket,
         CASE WHEN b.mpg_per_hp > s.mean_mpg_per_hp + 2 * s.stddev_mpg_per_hp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS anomaly_hp_bucket
  FROM base b
  JOIN stats s ON b.hp_bucket = s.hp_bucket
),
summary AS (
  SELECT 'MEAN' AS column00,
         NULL AS mpg,
         NULL AS hp,
         NULL AS disp,
         NULL AS wt,
         s.mean_mpg_per_hp AS mpg_per_hp,
         s.hp_bucket,
         NULL AS anomaly_hp_bucket
  FROM stats s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'STDDEV',
         NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
         s.stddev_mpg_per_hp,
         s.hp_bucket,
         NULL
  FROM stats s
),
final AS (
  SELECT * FROM main
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM summary
)
SELECT * FROM final
ORDER BY CASE WHEN column00 IN ('MEAN','STDDEV') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, mpg_per_hp DESC;"
  }
}
